The institutional investor held 22,974 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.85M, up from 19,736 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bangor Savings Bank who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company.
